hero.title: Polmaise Bowling Club
hero.intro: At the heart of Fallin since 1911. A friendly local club with a proud history, competitive bowls and a strong community spirit.

image.alt: The bowling green and clubhouse at Polmaise Bowling Club

latestResult.detail: Winners: William “Maxi” Maxwell, James Craig and Club President David Stewart — seven games, seven wins.

history.title: On this green since 1911
history.copy: Established in 1911, Polmaise Bowling Club has been a cornerstone of the Fallin community for generations. With deep roots in the local mining heritage, the club has welcomed bowlers of every generation to the green beside the village.

facts.label: At the heart of the village

membership.title: Start bowling at Polmaise
membership.copy: You do not need any experience to join us. Becoming a member is simple and straightforward: get in touch or call in at the club, try a free introductory session and meet the members.
